title: What Can You Do with an Old Shipping Container?
excerpt: Of the many amazing people I met on my recent trip to New Zealand, I especially enjoyed meeting some enterprising folks in Wellington who are repurposing shipping containers to deliver job training to folks in need. Learn more here … https://www.facebook.com/storiesespressobar
